definitions.short: Pau or Pai , a place in Edom
definitions.full: H6464. Pau or Pai מָּ֑עִי מָּ֑עוּ, proper name, of a location in Edom , מָּ֑עוּ Gen 36:39 = מָּ֑עִי 1Chr 1:50 ; Φογωρ , ᵐ5 L Chronicles Φαουα .

occurrences.englishText: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
